_source: NOT an RFC transcript — this one comes from a sibling implementation. awiki's anp-sdk, src/core/crypto/fingerprint.test.ts: `ED_PUB = ed25519.getPublicKey(new Uint8Array(32).fill(1))` and `ED_FP = 'e1_UDDReOZl1ipXAfp9wYsm13sDBMK5og--QWdBjzuf6o4'` (lines 11-12; the same string is written out as a literal JWK on line 41). The key is a seed of 32 bytes of 0x01 — chosen by that test, not by any standard.
_note: What is transcribed: the seed and `did_binding_segment` (that string is the sibling's own assertion). What was recomputed for this file, from the seed, by a second implementation (Python `cryptography` + `hashlib` + `json`) when it was written: `public_hex`, `required_members.x`, `canonical` and `sha256_hex`. Those four pin the intermediate steps rather than the endpoint — a compensating pair of errors on either side would otherwise still land on the right 43 characters.
